name: Memoria
detailed_description:
You've forgotten who you are- the world hasn't. 

In Memoria, you are a powerful—but aging—sorceress whose memory is slipping away. You awaken in a familiar but fragmented world, unsure of your purpose or past. To uncover the truth, you’ll explore mysterious forests, vibrant towns, and forgotten ruins—meeting old friends and dangerous foes along the way.

 Piece together your story by retracing old footsteps, rekindling bonds with familiar (yet distant) faces, and confronting enemies who remember you far better than you remember them. In Memoria, the truth isn’t something you discover—it’s something you remember.

Memoria is a hand-drawn 2D Metroidvania where magic is as much about memory as it is about power. Learn and re-learn spells as you recover lost fragments of your identity. Dash through dreamlike landscapes, unlock shortcuts with clever spellwork, and shape your path through a world that reveals itself at your pace.

Every choice you make echoes with meaning, weaving into a narrative that has already been written—one you’re only now remembering.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2048 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
  • Additional Notes: A controller is recommended for best experience.
